statement._text: Hey, [PlayerName]. Good to see you in one piece, how go your adventures?
I hear you defended your front of the battle with style, [PlayerName]. You should be proud. Even that bastard Sagard was impressed.
What happened with Calixa? How is she doing?
It’s strange to have her present in my mind like this, but I’m sure we’ll make it work. She’s already blessed me with great power. I feel like she’s always watching my back now.
(A wave of heat fills you, like the rays of the sun. Calixa speaks to you in your mind)
I’m...Adjusting. I won’t lie, this is a bizarre state of existence. I’m not sure I’ll ever get used to it. Still, I persist. It’s an improvement over death.
You’ve earned this reward, [PlayerName]. May you wear it well.
I name you Champion of the Heroic Kingdom of Levant, and give you freedom to pursue whatever desire you have. You have proven your skill and commitment to Levant, and I trust in your judgment.

Once Simeon is ready to return to Levant, I will as well. There is much to do if I’m going to live up to the title of goddess. I hope you will continue to offer your support. Our kingdom needs people like you.
The world is yours, [PlayerName]. Follow your heart, and nothing will stand in your way.

I hear you let those Scourge Beasts get the better of you. Well, no shame in that. Not everyone is cut out to be a badass. You did your best and casualties were kept to a minimum. That’s all that matters, really.
I'll organize a convoy to Monsoon immediately. [PlayerName], I need you to come to Monsoon as swiftly as possible.
Elatt damn it all...I got careless. Cyrene sniped Calixa from the balcony, and when I charged her, her goons poured shots down on me.

The bullet managed to penetrate her armor, the poison has gotten into her system. There's nothing I can do. Even if I purge the paralyzing effects from her body, this poison is full of Corruption that I can’t cleanse without fatal results.
(The warmth of a campfire fills your body. A strange voice speaks in the minds of everyone present)

Simeon, bring Calixa to Monsoon. I know of a way to save her life. Bring her to me, and accept terms of peace, and I will see to it that her life is saved. Until then, I will use what strength I can spare to keep her alive.
That voice in my head just now...That was Elatt? Is what he says true? Can he really save Calixa?
Yes. If Elatt says it, I believe him. We must bring Calixa to Monsoon as swiftly as possible if she is to survive.
I’ll come with you on the convoy.
I have something to do first. I’ll make my own way to Monsoon. I’ll meet you there.
Fine. But come to Monsoon as swiftly as possible. The longer we wait, the worse it will be for us.
Greetings. I hope you’re well!

I hope you can find Cyrene and Yzan before they turn on us, [PlayerName]. We've sent most of the guards from the palace to join the war. I'm pretty much the only one left to protect the palace if they start a civil war.
It’s a good thing you’re here, [PlayerName]. We’re going to bring the war to an end, but...Well, I’ll let Calixa explain. She’s better with words than me.
Farewell.
I want to train with you.

Hah, you want to learn from the best? Buy me a couple rounds at the inn, say about 50 silvers worth, and I’ll teach you the Deflection Strike. It’s a spear technique that’s both defensive and offensive that’s saved me several times.
Deal, here’s your money.
No, thanks.
Step outside and I’ll show you. First, you begin by baiting your foe with a low stance and prepare to counter it with a-
-And if they don’t fall for it, jab really quick at their shoulder height. You have no idea how often that catches people by surprise!
